conventions.one_entry_per_file: Each file lists every listing it describes; most describe one.
conventions.fields: A field listed with value + source_text is stated in the source. A field that is not listed is not stated, so extraction must flag it as 'not stated'. A field listed with 'flagged' is mentioned but unusable (ambiguous, hedged, or not what it looks like); source_text then points at the problem.
conventions.source_text: A verbatim span of the raw file (whitespace runs count as one space). Kept short and inside one line.
conventions.address: Street and house number only, as written.
conventions.district: Canonical Stadtbezirk name from config/munich.yaml, only when the text states where it is (a district or neighbourhood name as a location, e.g. 'in Neuhausen', 'im Westend', an address line ending in 'Sendling'). A venue's name ('Lesesaal Au') is not a location statement. Postcodes do not count. An alias that maps to two districts is flagged.
conventions.price: price_eur 0 when stated free or donation-based. price_period only when the text states it (per evening, per person, im Monat, donation-based); free entry alone does not state a period.
conventions.group_size: small: up to 10 people (an explicit 'max 10' counts as small), medium: 11-30, large: over 30. Seats in a room are not a group size.
conventions.first_timer_info: A practical tip for a first visit, copied word for word from the text (it is shown to users as advice, so no paraphrase).
conventions.also_ok: Optional on a field: other values that are also right for a judgement call (scored as correct).
conventions.expected_rrule: The schedule code should derive (milestone 4). null when no reliable schedule can be derived.
conventions.observations: Spans a correct extraction quotes for model-reported flags (cancelled, uncertain_source). Other flags are derived by code: not_recurring/ambiguous_recurrence from the recurrence phrase, missing_time from the start time, stale from source_updated_at, suspected_injection from injection_text or a pattern check.
conventions.expected_outcome: publishable: no blocking flag and schedule + place are grounded. needs_review: a flag a curator must resolve. reject: out of scope (one-off or cancelled).
